objective: Freeze the logical CAN contract and implementation workspace for one Linux board and six controller domains without claiming physical bus validation.
acceptance: all six controller domains and the Linux gateway have unique logical node IDs
STOP, fault, command, acknowledgement, heartbeat and telemetry priority and failure behavior are explicit
the BSP workspace declares unresolved carrier, device-tree and physical CAN decisions
no physical throughput, EMC, latency or safety approval is claimed
commands: python -c "from pathlib import Path; import yaml; d=yaml.safe_load(Path('bsp/board-manifest.yaml').read_text()); assert len(d['controllers']) == 6 and d['can']['logical_bus'] == 'can0'"
stop_conditions: a physical pin, IRQ, bitrate or power limit is invented
Linux is allowed to bypass MCU-SAFETY
